data.description:
## Context / Problem

The project pins Opus 4.8, Sonnet 4.6 and Haiku 4.5 (`rebar.toml` `[llm] model` and `[llm.model_classes]`, `.github/llm-providers/bedrock.toml`, `.github/llm-providers/anthropic.toml`). Bedrock in account 896586841071/us-east-1 now serves the inference profiles `us.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5`, `us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5` and `us.anthropic.claude-haiku-5-5` (confirmed with `aws bedrock list-inference-profiles --profile frontier --region us-east-1`; status ACTIVE). The parent epic requires this upgrade to land first, on the current 4-pass engine, before any engine work.

The 5.5 generation changes the request surface, so a bare id swap is unsafe:

- forced `tool_choice` `any`/`tool` returns 400 on Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5;
- thinking cannot be disabled on Opus 5.5 (`disabled` and `budget_tokens` both 400);
- `temperature`, `top_p` and `top_k` are rejected (non-default values 400);
- assistant prefill is rejected;
- Opus 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 default `effort` to `medium`, one level below the `high` default the current Opus 4.8 and Sonnet 4.6 run at.

The installed runtime does not know these models. `pydantic-ai-slim` 1.107.9 (the newest 1.x, 1.107.10, is a security-only release) builds Claude profiles in `pydantic_ai/profiles/anthropic.py::anthropic_model_profile` from prefix lists that end at `claude-opus-4-8`/`claude-fable-5`. For `claude-opus-5-5` it therefore reports `anthropic_supports_forced_tool_choice=True`, `anthropic_supports_effort=False`, `anthropic_supports_adaptive_thinking=False` and `anthropic_disallows_sampling_settings=False` — every one wrong for 5.5.

## Approach

Swap the ids, then make the request surface correct for 5.5 at the seams rebar already owns, and prove it on the wire.

**Riskiest assumption first.** The plan assumes rebar's calls carry no forced tool choice, no thinking toggle and no prefill, so that only sampling and effort need code. Code reading supports it: structured output is selected by `structured.output_mode` (`src/rebar/llm/structured.py:149`), which returns only `NativeOutput` or `PromptedOutput`, never a tool output, and `capabilities._REBAR_OVERRIDES` (`src/rebar/llm/capabilities.py:214`) pins every Claude model to `native_structured_output=False`, so Claude always takes `PromptedOutput` (no tool, no prefill); no `src/rebar` caller sets `RunRequest.thinking=True` (`src/rebar/llm/runner.py:93`, only read at `structured_run.py:102`); agentic tool loops leave `tool_choice` at pydantic-ai's `auto`. Step 1 tests that on the wire before any further edit: run the existing step-1 probe, `python -m rebar.llm.evals.provider_parity --probe` (`provider_parity.py:589`), for each class slot against the 5.5 ids, and record each 400 it raises. Only after the probe is clean do the remaining steps proceed.

**Id and table changes.** Replace the 4.x ids with the 5.5 ids verbatim from the inference-profile list in `rebar.toml`, `.github/llm-providers/bedrock.toml` and `.github/llm-providers/anthropic.toml` (direct ids `claude-opus-5-5`, `claude-sonnet-5-5`, `claude-haiku-5-5`, no date suffix), `config.DEFAULT_MODEL` and `config.VERIFIER_DEFAULT_MODEL` (`src/rebar/llm/config.py:61,67`), `model_classes.TRIVIAL_DEFAULT_MODEL` and `MODEL_WINDOW_LADDER` (`src/rebar/llm/model_classes.py:45,62-66`; Haiku 5.5's window is 1M, up from 200K), `review_kernel/verify.py::MODEL_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS` (`:294-297`; Haiku 5.5 max output 128K), `bedrock_model.DEFAULT_BEDROCK_MODEL_ID` (`src/rebar/llm/bedrock_model.py:22`), `provider_parity.CLASS_SLOTS` (`src/rebar/llm/evals/provider_parity.py:103-106`), the `model:` pin of each `src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/*.eval.yaml`, and the deploy defaults in `infra/compose/docker-compose.yml:97-99` and the CloudWatch dimensions in `infra/terraform/monitoring_eb6e.tf`. The `sizing.py` family ladder (`_RUNG_CLASSES`, `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/sizing.py:240`) keys on `haiku`/`sonnet`/`opus` substrings and needs no change; a test pins that 5.5 ids still resolve to their class.

**Sampling.** Add every 5.5 id (bare, `us.` and `global.`) to `_MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES` (`capabilities.py:223`) with `supports_temperature: False`, the same mechanism that already withdraws `temperature` for Opus 4.7/4.8. `structured_run.py:400-404` and `runner.py:503-511` then omit the Pass-2 `temperature=0`.

**Effort, set explicitly.** Send `effort` on every 5.5 call from one per-model table beside the overrides: `high` for Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 (the level Opus 4.8 and Sonnet 4.6 run at today by default), `medium` for Haiku 5.5 (its default; Haiku 4.5 had no effort). It is wired where `structured_run.build_model_settings` and `agent_call.build_agent_kwargs` assemble `model_settings`, through the provider-scoped keys: `bedrock_additional_model_requests_fields={"output_config": {"effort": ...}}` on Bedrock, and `anthropic_effort` on direct Anthropic. Because pydantic-ai only honours `anthropic_effort` when the profile reports `anthropic_supports_effort`, the direct-Anthropic profile is corrected at the provider seam rebar already owns (`providers.py` `provider_factory`, `:136`): for 5.5 ids its `model_profile` reports adaptive thinking, effort and xhigh support, `anthropic_supports_forced_tool_choice=False` and `anthropic_disallows_sampling_settings=True`. The same correction makes pydantic-ai fall back to `auto` instead of sending `any` if a future caller requests a forced tool.

**Cache minimum.** Add `claude-opus-5-5`, `claude-sonnet-5-5` and `claude-haiku-5-5` to `_MODEL_CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS` (`capabilities.py:38`) at 512 tokens, the documented minimum for the 5.5 generation.

**Audit and record.** Walk every model call site (`runner.py`, `structured_run.py`, `agent_call.py`, `anthropic_model.py`, `bedrock_model.py`, `providers.py`, `review_kernel/`, `plan_review/passes.py`, `workflow/`) against the five API changes plus the refusal stop reason (`stop_reason: "refusal"`, new on the Haiku line), and record one row per check (site, finding, fix or "not affected") as a ticket comment. An incompatibility that needs more than this ticket's seams is filed as a bug linked `discovered_from`.

This approach fits because the request surface is already single-sourced in those seams: the override table, the settings builders and the provider factory are where every call is shaped, so correcting them corrects every pass at once without touching the passes.

## Scope

- rebar.toml
- .github/llm-providers/bedrock.toml
- .github/llm-providers/anthropic.toml
- src/rebar/llm/config.py
- src/rebar/llm/model_classes.py
- src/rebar/llm/capabilities.py
- src/rebar/llm/structured_run.py
- src/rebar/llm/agent_call.py
- src/rebar/llm/providers.py
- src/rebar/llm/bedrock_model.py
- src/rebar/llm/review_kernel/verify.py
- src/rebar/llm/evals/provider_parity.py
- src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/*.eval.yaml (model pins)
- src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/provider_parity_results.json (re-recorded run)
- infra/compose/docker-compose.yml
- infra/terraform/monitoring_eb6e.tf
- tests/unit/test_capabilities.py, tests/unit/test_model_classes.py, tests/unit/test_llm_provider_factory.py, tests/unit/test_project_default_provider.py (existing pins updated, new cases added)

## Testing

- Happy path: `tests/unit/test_capabilities.py` asserts each 5.5 id (bare, `us.`, `global.`) reports `supports_temperature=False` and a 512-token cache minimum; a settings-builder test asserts a 5.5 Bedrock request carries `output_config.effort` and no `temperature`, and a direct one carries `anthropic_effort`.
- Failure/edge: a test asserts the corrected direct profile reports `anthropic_supports_forced_tool_choice=False`, so a forced choice degrades to `auto`; a test asserts an unmapped model id still keeps the family defaults (no effort sent, temperature kept); `sizing` resolves `us.anthropic.claude-haiku-5-5` to `trivial`.
- Live end-to-end: the provider-parity probe and full run, and the prompt evals (`rebar.llm.evals.eval.run_eval` over each dataset-bearing spec, the `eval-live` job's loop in `.github/workflows/prompt-eval.yml`, at `REBAR_EVAL_MAX_CASES=12`), each run once on the current models before the change and once on 5.5 after, with `AWS_PROFILE=frontier-bedrock`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `rebar.toml`, `.github/llm-providers/bedrock.toml` and `model_classes.MODEL_WINDOW_LADDER` name Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5; `git grep -nE 'claude-(opus-4-8|sonnet-4-6|haiku-4-5)' -- rebar.toml .github/llm-providers src/rebar/llm/config.py src/rebar/llm/model_classes.py` prints nothing.
- [ ] The model-call audit is recorded as a ticket comment with one row per call site and API change, and every incompatibility it finds is fixed in this change or filed as a linked bug.
- [ ] `tests/unit/test_capabilities.py` and the settings-builder tests named under Testing pass, pinning no-temperature, explicit effort and the corrected forced-tool-choice flag for 5.5.
- [ ] The provider-parity probe passes on all 5.5 slots, and the provider-parity run and prompt-eval results before and after the change are recorded as a ticket comment; the 5.5 provider-parity run reports `invalid: false` with no `sampling_parameter` or `auth_validation` errors.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.
data.title: Upgrade configured models to Opus 5.5 / Sonnet 5.5 / Haiku 5.5 and audit every model call
